note: Hard-skill taxonomy for fourteen technical careers. Soft and managerial skills are out of scope because they cannot be assessed with multiple-choice questions and no course teaches them like a tool or a method.

skills.name: SQL & Kueri Basis Data
skills.description: Menulis kueri SQL untuk mengambil, menggabungkan, dan meringkas data dari basis data relasional.

skills.name: Statistika

skills.name: Analisis Data
